lesson.name: Learn The Scandinavian Defense
lesson.description: Learn the main lines and key ideas for both sides in the Scandinavian Defense.

{Any second move by White besides exd5 gives Black an easy game. How should
you fight for the center after 2.e5?} 2... c5 {[%wrong There's a better option.
Try again and look for a good way to control the center with pawns.] [%hint
Control the d4-square with a pawn.] Well played! White can't easily occupy the
center with more than just the e-pawn and Black is doing well.} (2... Bf5 $5 {
This is playable, but it's best to control d4 with a pawn. How should you do
it?}) (2... a6 $5 {This is playable, but it's best to control d4 with a pawn.
How should you do it?}) (2... e6 $2 3. d4 {White occupies the center and
transposes to the French Defense. Try again and look for a way to prevent
White from safely placing a pawn on d4.}) (2... d4 $5 {This is playable, but
it's best to control d4 with a pawn instead of occupying it. How should you do
that?}) (2... f6 $2 3. d4 {There's no need to expose the black king. Try to
find a way to fight for the center without moving the f-pawn.}) *

{If White doesn't immediately attack the black queen on d5, Black can quickly
reach a safe position. How should you liquidate the white center?} 3... e5 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a way to attack the
white center.] [%hint Offer a pawn trade in the center.]} (3... Nc6 $5 {
This is a decent way to attack d4, but it's stronger to offer a pawn trade in
the center. How should you do it?}) (3... c5 $2 4. Nf3 {It's better to release
your f8-bishop while attacking the d4-pawn. How can you do that?}) (3... e6 $2
4. c4 {White chases away the black queen, with a good position. Try again and
look for a way to target the d4-pawn}) (3... Bf5 $2 4. Nc3 {White chases away
the black queen, with a good position. Try again and look for a way to target
the d4-pawn.}) 4. dxe5 {Nice move! What should you capture?} Qxd1+ {[%wrong
There's a better option. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Trade
queens to prevent White from castling.] Great move! White's king is stuck in
the center and Black will soon aim to win back the e5-pawn with Nc6.} (4...
Qxe5+ $5 {This is OK, but there's an even better capture. Try to find it.}) *

{Black has captured a poisoned pawn on d4. How should White take advantage?} 9.
Nb5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and check the hint if you're
stuck.] [%hint Sacrifice a knight to threaten a fork on c7 and make Black open
the a4-e8 diagonal.]} (9. Rd1 $2 Qb6 {Black is OK. Try again and look for a
stronger threat.}) 9... cxb5 {Great move! How should you justify the piece
sacrifice?} 10. Bxb5+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a
good capture.] [%hint Capture a pawn with check.]} (10. Qxb7 $2 Qe4+ {Black
forces a queen trade, with an OK position. Try again and look for a stronger
capture.}) (10. Rd1 $2 Qb6 {Black keeps a material advantage. Try again and
look for a strong capture.}) 10... Nbd7 {Nice work! How should you keep up the
attack?} 11. Qxb7 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a
strong capture.] [%hint Capture a pawn and attack the a8-rook.]} (11. Rd1 $2
Qb4+ {Black uses a fork to win the b5-bishop. Try again and look for a strong
capture.}) (11. Bxd7+ $2 Qxd7 {Black keeps a material advantage. Try again and
look for a stronger capture.}) 11... Rd8 {Good choice! How should you win
material?} 12. Bc7 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a
strong threat.] [%hint Target the d8-rook.] Well done! White will win the rook
on d8 and then follow up with Rd1 and target the pinned knight. Black is in
serious trouble.} (12. Rd1 $2 Qe4+ {Black trades queens with a good position.
Try again and look for a stronger threat.}) *

{How should Black refute White's inadvisable Bxf7+ sacrifice?} 7... Kxf7 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a way out of check.] 
[%hint Capture the checking piece.]} (7... Kd8 $2 8. h3 {White keeps an extra
pawn and Black is in trouble. Try again and look for a stronger option.}) (7...
Kd7 $2 8. O-O {White keeps an extra pawn and Black is in trouble. Try again
and look for a stronger option.}) 8. Ne5+ {White hopes to win back a piece
with a knight fork, but Black has other plans. What should you play?} Qxe5+ {
[%wrong Illegal] [%hint Sacrifice your queen to stop the check.]} (8... Ke8 $2
9. Nxg4 {White wins material. Try again and look for a stronger move.}) (8...
Ke6 $2 9. Nxg4 {White wins material. Try again and look for a stronger move.})
(8... Kg8 $2 9. Nxg4 {White wins material. Try again and look for a stronger
move.}) 9. dxe5 {Great move! How should you win material?} Bxd1 {[%wrong
There's a stronger move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint
Capture the queen.] Well played! Black will emerge with an extra piece and a
winning position.} *

{How should White take advantage of the exposed black queen?} 11. Nb5 {[%wrong
There's a stronger option. Try again and look for a good threat.] [%hint Use a
discovered attack to threaten the black queen and a check on c7 or d6.]} (11.
Rc1 $5 {White is doing well, but there's a better move to take advantage of
the vulnerable black queen. How should you do it?}) (11. g5 $5 {White is doing
well, but there's a better move to take advantage of the vulnerable black
queen. How should you do it?}) (11. Ng5 $5 {White is doing well, but there's a
better move to take advantage of the vulnerable black queen. How should you do
it?}) (11. Nd5 $2 Qd8 {White has only a small advantage. Try again and look
for a better knight move.}) (11. Ne4 $5 Qc7 {White is doing well, but there's
a stronger way to attack the queen. Try to find it.}) 11... Qb6 {Good start!
How should you win material?} 12. Nd6+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try
again and look for a strong check.] [%hint Take advantage of the pin on e7 to
play a safe check.]} (12. Bxf7+ $5 {White is doing well, but there's an even
stronger check. Try to find it.}) 12... Kd8 {Good choice! How should you keep
up the attack?} 13. Nxf7+ {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look
for a good check.] [%hint Fork Black's king and the h8-rook.]} (13. Nxb7+ $2
Qxb7 {White is doing well, but there's a much stronger capture. Try to find it.
}) 13... Kc8 {Well played! How should you cash in?} 14. Nxh8 {[%wrong There's
a stronger option. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture an
undefended piece.] Well done! White wins a rook and should win the game.} (14.
O-O $5 {This is a good move, but there's a capture that's better. Try to find
it.}) (14. Rc1 $5 {This is a good move, but there's a capture that's better.
Try to find it.}) (14. Be6 $5 {This is a good move, but there's a capture
that's better. Try to find it.}) (14. Bc3 $5 {This is a good move, but there's
a capture that's better. Try to find it.}) *

{White has an enormous lead in development and a winning attack. How should
you take advantage?} 14. Nxg6 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and
look for a strong capture.] [%hint Trade off a defender of the f7-pawn.]} (14.
Nfxe6 $2 fxe6 {White has good compensation for the sacrificed piece, but
there's a much stronger capture. Try to find it.}) (14. Ngxe6 $2 fxe6 {White
has good compensation for the sacrificed piece, but there's a much stronger
capture. Try to find it.}) (14. Nxf7 $2 Bxf7 {Black wins mateiral. Try again
and look for a stronger capture.}) (14. h4 $5 {White is doing well, but
there's a capture that's even stronger. Try to find it.}) 14... hxg6 {Nice
move! How should White destroy the black king's defenses?} 15. Nxf7 {[%wrong
There's a stronger move. Try again and look for good capture.] [%hint
Sacrifice the knight to decoy the black king into danger.]} (15. Nxe6 $2 fxe6 {
White doesn't have enough compensation for the sacrificed material. Try again
and look for a stronger capture.}) (15. Bxe6 $2 fxe6 {White doesn't have
enough compensation for the sacrificed material. Try again and look for a
stronger capture.}) 15... Kxf7 {Black would have been better off leaving the
knight on f7, but that would cost at least a rook. How can White win the game
after Kxf7?} 16. Qxe6# {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for
a way to end the game.] [%hint Look at your checks. Which one is mate?] Well
done!} *

{What's the best way to develop the c1-bishop?} 9. Bd2 {[%wrong There's a
stronger option. Try again and look for the best square for your c1-bishop.] 
[%hint Develop your bishop to unpin the c3-knight and prepare a discovered
attack on the black queen.] Good work! Black must constantly be on the lookout
for discovered attacks, and will most likely retreat the queen soon.} (9. Be3
$2 Ba3 {Black takes advantage of the pin on c3 to create counterplay. Try
again and look for a stronger bishop move.}) (9. Bf4 $2 Nbd7 {White has a
slight advantage, but there's a stronger square for the c1-bishop. Try to find
it.}) (9. Bg5 $2 Qxg5 {Black wins the bishop. Try to find a better square for
it.}) *

{How can White prevent Black from castling?} 12. Bg5 {[%wrong There's a better
move. Try again and look for a strong threat.] [%hint Improve your bishop and
attack the black queen.]} (12. h3 $5 {This is reasonable, but there's an
aggressive and stronger option. Try to find it.}) (12. Rhe1 $2 Bg4 {Black pins
the white knight with a safe position. Try again and look for a good threat.})
12... Qg6 {Nice move! How should you keep the black king from castling?} 13.
Bxe7 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a good capture.]
[%hint Trade pieces to force Black to recapture with the king.] Great job!
After Kxe7 Black's king will struggle to find shelter for the rest of the game.
} (13. h4 $5 {This is OK, but there's a capture that's even stronger. Try to
find it.}) (13. Bf4 $2 Nb6 {Black has a comfortable position. Try again and
look for a strong capture.}) (13. Nh4 $2 Qxg5+ {Black wins material. Try again
and look for a strong capture.}) *

{Magnus Carlsen has established a solid position and then began to break down
the white pawn center. How did he do it?} 27... f6 {[%wrong There's a better
option. Try again and look for a useful pawn break.] [%hint Offer a trade for
the e5-pawn.]} (27... Nc8 $5 {This is reasonable, but Carlsen preferred to
immediately attack the white pawn center. How did he do it?}) (27... c5 $2 28.
Nxb7 {White wins material. Try again and look for a stronger way to attack the
white center.}) 28. Kc2 {White can't trade on f6 without losing the d6-knight.
How did Carlsen continue to attack the white center?} fxe5 {[%wrong There's a
better option. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Trade pawns in
the center.] Well played! White must recapture and accept an isolated pawn on
e5. Black soon won that weak pawn and later won the game in Caruana - Carlsen,
2014.} (28... Nc8 $5 {This is OK, but Carlsen preferred to trade pawns first.
How did he do it?}) *
